'''Takanori Hoshino''' (Japanese: '''星野貴紀''' ''Hoshino Takanori'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hoshino was born on May 8, 1980, in {{wp|Mooka, Tochigi}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He was affiliated with Office PAC. Hoshino became involved with {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing two characters: [[Jervis]], {{an|Cynthia}}'s butler in [[Undella Town]]; and [[Dirk]]'s {{p|Tyranitar}}. He also voiced [[Bruno]], a member of the [[Kanto]] [[Elite Four]], in [[Pokémon Generations]].
